entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a support agent now.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for an order I placed a couple of months ago. It's for a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Great, thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Road Cycling Shoes, delivered on October 13th. That was about 56 days ago. Can I ask what the issue is with the shoes?
They just don't fit right. I've tried everything, adjusted the cleats multiple times, but they keep giving me terrible blisters after any ride longer than ten miles. They're just not working for me.
I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers.

Yeah, it's a shame. Look, I know it's been a while since I bought them. If a full refund isn't possible, would you consider giving me a 50% store credit? Or maybe a discount code for a different pair? I'd be willing to try another model.

I appreciate the offer, but let me just check the policy for you. One moment... Okay, I've confirmed it. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the delivery date. Since you're at 56 days, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh! Really? That's great news. I was expecting it to be a bit more complicated. So a full refund is okay?

Yes, absolutely. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on your account right now. Just pack the cycling shoes in any box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we will process your refund back to the original payment method.
That's fantastic. Much easier than I thought. Thank you so much for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Have a wonderful day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
